G1_unambiguity.justification: The product condition unambiguously requires every pair of selected relays to have different values in all three coordinates.

G2_completeness.justification: The statement specifies the constraints, input format, uniqueness condition, edge case for \(k=1\), and accepted output format completely.

G3_faithfulness.justification: Because exactly \(k\) values are chosen from coordinate ranges of size \(k\), pairwise distinctness in each coordinate is equivalent to using every original group member exactly once.

G4_naturalness.justification: The statement is clear and readable, though the artificial relay framing and elaborate product formulation are somewhat less natural than directly stating the distinctness requirement.
